summary: 普通文本输入需要与终端命令行一致的光标动画
expected: 单行输入在聚焦且光标折叠时绘制同一共享呼吸光标；不支持文本选区的类型、密码、数字、只读/禁用与强制颜色回退原生 caret
acceptanceCriteria: UiInput 以 ui-input-shell 包裹原生输入，光标层与输入框内边距和滚动对齐
呼吸节奏与终端命令行共用 motion token 与 keyframes
Vue 与 React 适配结构一致，SSR 不渲染光标层
单测覆盖显示与回退，XCA-Portal 类型与门禁通过

consumers.scenario: 终端内交互表单的输入行需要与命令行一致的焦点反馈

resolution: UiInput renders ui-input-shell and shares the ui-caret-breathe keyframes and caret motion tokens with UiTerminalPrompt; Vue and React adapters mirror selection, scroll, composition and hold state; unit tests in packages/vue/src/components.test.ts and packages/react/src/index.test.ts; UI lint/contracts and playground-controls, terminal-surface and react-parity visual suites pass; XCA-Portal check, typecheck and terminal E2E pass.
